summary.en: The same grid re-sorted: the matches light up in place, then fly back first in the accent while one big number counts them; the share enters once the count has landed.
summary.zh: 同一张方格重新排序：符合条件的先原地亮起，再带着强调色飞回最前面，一个大数字数出它们；占比等数字落定后才出现。

fits: Which subset: one flag or one category over the whole set, told as a count.
notFor: Two subsets at once; a subset too small to see (under about 1 % of the set).

intent.en: A subset is counted where it lives: the matches light up inside the whole, fly out first, and one number counts them.
intent.zh: 子集在原处被数出来：符合的方块在整体里亮起、先飞出来，一个数字数它们。

content.en: Groups (2–9) and which of them match; a title (≤ 44 / 16 字), a count label and a share line (≤ 30 / 12 字).
content.zh: 分组（2–9）与其中哪些符合；标题（≤ 44 / 16 字）、计数标签和占比一行（≤ 30 / 12 字）。

fits.zh: 哪个子集：整体上的一个标记或类别，用计数讲。

notFor.zh: 同时两个子集；小到看不见的子集（不到约 1 %）。

en: Show the share only after the count lands; two numbers at once split the reading.
zh: 占比要在计数落定后再出；两个数字同时出会分散阅读。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
